svg.title: Chain of custody ledger
svg.desc: 2 sealed entries. Head 0106fc9c009f3d34f0984513eaec972cf09e8973ac0494ba21b7a5c0dddb8ab5. Verify with python verify.py.
svg.text: Each day of public activity is hashed into the entry that follows it. Alter one, and every later hash breaks.

text.tspan: git clone https://github.com/alanhasn/alanhasn && cd alanhasn && python verify.py
